explanation: Implemented all 10 B02 edits from the pinned sources. Added repository capture, persisted diff-tree evidence, migration checks and decorations, compact API reads, and explicit review navigation. Preserved proposal history, receipts, atomic acceptance, and retained attachment labels. Corrected native edge layering. Existing diagrams fit their reserved bounds; only the planned edge is added. The new review diagram leaves room for later coverage navigation, treemaps, and generation workflows without presenting them as implemented.
